mappingPolicy.rule: One public Design ID maps to at most one verified development public identity. Internal Figma anatomy, variant sets and slots are not additional mapping identities.
mappingPolicy.missingDevelopmentBehavior: Widget and Composite entries without a verified public runtime identity use ENGINEERING_GAP with developmentComponentId=null. LayoutHelper and Asset entries use NOT_APPLICABLE for QWidget implementation, keep developmentComponentId=null and record their owner-specific consumerEngineeringStatus.

kindPolicy.existingEntries: Derive Widget versus Composite from the verified legacy engineering mapping, then reconcile the canonical identity with current Figma.

componentSetPolicy.rule: Every Figma Component Set must be referenced by exactly one Canonical Library entry or explicitly classified here. INTERNAL, PROPOSAL and RESIDUE sets never create a second public component identity.

tokenAuthority.limitation: A positive binding count proves traceability to a Figma variable, not complete role coverage or runtime token consumption.

engineeringEvidence.boundary: No Widget or Composite engineering gaps remain. The 2 LayoutHelpers and 3 Assets use engineeringStatus=NOT_APPLICABLE for QWidget implementation and consumerEngineeringStatus=IMPLEMENTED for their owner-specific runtime chains; they must not enter ComponentFactory or receive fake QWidget identities.

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: The button retains Qt::StrongFocus and keyboard activation. Figma focus-visible is an input-modality preview; the shared FocusIndicator may suppress only the painted ring per component without changing focusPolicy or activation.
The checkbox retains Qt::StrongFocus, Space activation and accessibility behavior. Figma Focus-visible is a visual preview; ring suppression never changes check state, focusPolicy or keyboard input.

The root composition remains Qt::NoFocus while its editor keeps native keyboard focus, IME and clipboard behavior. A root focusIndicatorEnabled override is inherited by the field chrome and child actions; it hides only the visual ring.

The SDK maps the 34 valid Figma variants. QAction remains optional command authority; QMenu ownership, popup timing, activation and focus return remain native Qt runtime behavior. Menu=None preserves an existing non-split popup mode.

The root is a presentation/layout host. Native child buttons retain ButtonRole and platform QStyle ordering. DestructiveRole is not converted into accepted(), and Delete is never the Enter default. A root ring opt-out is inherited by all watched child buttons.
The SDK maps presentation and persistent checked state. Choice-group exclusivity, current selection and wizard or dialog navigation remain host-controller responsibilities.
QAction remains command identity and data authority; hover, active and keyboard highlight are transient native states, while MenuItem remains internal anatomy.
QAction and ComponentLab/Menu remain shared runtime authorities; open, hover, keyboard and disabled are native action states, while the corner widget content remains consumer-owned.
QAction remains shared command authority; QMainWindow owns real docking and floating lifecycle, while the Figma Placement axis is a deterministic appearance specimen.
QTabWidget owns page visibility, keyboard selection, close-request signaling and page attachment; generated pages own close confirmation, deletion and persistence. TabItem remains internal anatomy.
QToolBox owns single-current-page selection and attached item pages. All-collapsed and multi-open behavior belongs to Collapse, not ToolBox; ToolBoxItem remains internal anatomy.

Area and Placement are design previews only. QMainWindow owns actual docking and tabification; floating, allowedAreas and DockWidgetFeatures remain native runtime authority and are never inferred from Figma variant values.

State is deterministic paint metadata. Activation, QWidget window states, enabled, WindowFlags, close veto, system menu, move/resize and ownership remain native runtime authority and are never inferred as one mutually exclusive property.

Free, Cascade and Tile are deterministic authored geometry previews, not Qt viewMode values or arrangement commands. Tabbed maps to QMdiArea::TabbedView; subsequent arrangement, activation, lifecycle, close veto, persistence and ownership remain runtime-owned.

Empty, Content and Disabled map to native page count/currentWidget/enabled semantics. The stack has no selector, route history or transition policy; removeWidget retains ownership and generated-page controllers own routing.
Kind maps to setCommitPage/setFinalPage. Completion is paint metadata only and never replaces isComplete, mandatory fields, validatePage, nextId or initialize/cleanup lifecycle hooks.

Style maps to the writable wizardStyle property. Phase is workflow preview metadata and never writes read-only currentId or visitedIds; branching, validation, button roles and accept/reject lifecycle remain QWizard authority.
Stable destinations, selection synchronization and page switching remain generated-page responsibilities; internal item sets remain SDK anatomy.

MetricCard owns the card surface, state fallback copy and comparison or meta text. It does not parse or localize numeric values; consumers that need numeric formatting use ComponentLab/Statistic. Loading never exposes stale value content, while Empty and Error are explicit semantic states rather than numeric zero.

The SDK retains the raw numeric value separately from locale-formatted display text and affixes. Loading suppresses stale values; Empty and Error remain semantic fallbacks and never collapse to numeric zero. Update cadence and dynamic accessibility-announcement throttling remain host responsibilities.

Start and End are logical design values resolved against QWidget layoutDirection. QLabel retains native text, pixmap, links, buddy and selection behavior; Label remains presentation-only and Qt::NoFocus.

Determinate and Indeterminate map to native range mode, Disabled maps to QWidget enabled state, and Paused/Error/In-progress/Completed are horizontal visual semantics only. Runtime owns numeric value, range and update cadence; Figma busy frames are static review slices and do not define motion timing.

The splitter root is Qt::NoFocus and does not paint a universal focus ring. Pane widgets own keyboard focus. Legal ranges, collapsibility, persisted sizes and application-specific pane content remain generated-page responsibilities; Show grip changes only the visual grip and never the handle hit target.

The SDK owns the token-backed viewport and scrollbar identities. Content ownership, content size, scroll position and application data remain generated-page responsibilities. Qt::StrongFocus preserves keyboard scrolling; focusIndicatorEnabled may suppress only the painted ring.

The SDK owns Figma header geometry, single-letter weekday labels, grid presentation and semantic date-cell painting. Date range, locale, business-day rules, initial page and selected date remain runtime or generated-page data.

visualVerificationEvidencePolicy.method: Live Figma component-set screenshot compared with ComponentLab --capture-page output from the published GenerateComponent SDK across all four runtime profiles.
visualVerificationEvidencePolicy.meaning: VERIFIED proves the named component set's governed variants, anatomy, text defaults, geometry and token-driven light/dark presentation were visually inspected in the stated runtime build. It does not grant designer or governance approval and does not prove host-owned data pipelines or interaction behavior.

ComponentLab/Chart.scope: Six Kind=Bar|Line|Status by State=Data|Empty variants; root card, header, plot, grid, series, status segments, legend, empty region and default text properties.
ComponentLab/Chart.limitations: Line reference SVG is the governed visual specimen; arbitrary line-series serialization, domains, axes, labels, animation, keyboard exploration and accessible text equivalents remain host-owned engineering work. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

ComponentLab/Sidebar.scope: Four Density=Comfortable|Compact by Collapsed=False|True public variants; header, logo, collapse action, route list, active route, settings action, spacing, radius and theme surface.
ComponentLab/Sidebar.limitations: The 16 DSM/Sidebar/NavItem states remain private anatomy rather than a second SDK identity. Route permissions, navigation resolution and page switching remain host-owned. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

ComponentLab/Calendar.scope: Eight WeekStart=Monday|Sunday by Grid=True|False by State=Default|Disabled variants; 440 by 360 frame, month header, navigation arrows, weekday order, zero-padded dates, reference date 15 and selected date 23.
ComponentLab/Calendar.limitations: The evidence fixes the September 2026 design specimen. Date range, locale overrides, business-day rules, initial page and host-owned selected date remain runtime concerns. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

ComponentLab/Splitter.scope: Ten Orientation=Horizontal|Vertical by State=Default|Hover|Dragging|Collapsed|Disabled variants; 12 px handle, 4 by 32 or 32 by 4 grip, collapsed first pane and 2 px dragging-position evidence.
ComponentLab/Splitter.limitations: Pane content, legal ranges, collapse policy and saved sizes remain host-owned; the Dragging state is a deterministic review specimen while live movement remains native QSplitter behavior. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

ComponentLab/Select.scope: Public outlined Select variants across Small, Middle and Large sizes and Default, Hover, Focus and Disabled states; fixed 240 px field width, captured heights, text, chevron, outline and profile presentation.
ComponentLab/Select.limitations: The larger page also contains internal anatomy and other governed Select families. Only the canonical public outlined set is the direct live-Figma comparison target; popup data, filtering, keyboard selection and validation controllers remain host-owned. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

ComponentLab/RadioButton.scope: Ten Value=Off|On by State=Default|Hover|Focus|Pressed|Disabled variants; 18 px indicator, centered selected dot, label baseline, grouped horizontal and vertical examples and disabled evidence.
ComponentLab/RadioButton.limitations: Mutual exclusion, data binding and group validation remain native QButtonGroup or host-controller concerns. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

ComponentLab/Switch.scope: Twenty-four Size=Medium|Small by Value=Off|On by State=Default|Hover|Pressed|Focus-visible|Loading|Disabled variants; 180 by 32 root, optional label, non-stretching 36 by 20 or 28 by 16 track, 2 px inset, knob and loading indicator.
ComponentLab/Switch.limitations: Loading blocks duplicate input while preserving the binary Value. Async lifecycle, persistence and business confirmation remain host-owned. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

ComponentLab/Tooltip.scope: Twelve Placement=TopLeft|Top|TopRight|RightTop|Right|RightBottom|BottomRight|Bottom|BottomLeft|LeftBottom|Left|LeftTop variants; Helpful context default, token-driven surface and content, placement-specific arrows, four runtime profiles and explicit multiline sizing evidence.
ComponentLab/Tooltip.limitations: The component-set screenshot proves the twelve authored placements while the separate review frame and runtime test prove multiline content. Window-edge collision avoidance still requires a visible host-level interaction pass. Formal designer and governance approval remain open.

tokenBindingEvidencePolicy.method: Live Figma get_variable_defs query against the canonical public component node or component-set node.
tokenBindingEvidencePolicy.meaning: BOUND_VERIFIED proves that the queried canonical Figma node returned at least one variable definition. It does not prove complete semantic-role coverage, runtime token consumption, pixel parity, visual approval or governance approval.
